resources.string: Wireless screen mirroring from your iPhone
No network. Connect this TV box to Wi‑Fi or Ethernet.
CHOOSE THIS NAME ON YOUR IPHONE
This is the name your iPhone shows under Screen Mirroring.
%1$s wants to connect — open the app to allow it
%1$s wants to mirror its screen to this TV.
A new device shows an Allow/Deny prompt here first.
Require a PIN on the iPhone
The iPhone must enter a code shown on this TV.
Not built yet — still using Ask on the TV for now.
No prompt — every device connects automatically.
Connect your iPhone to the same Wi‑Fi as this TV
Open Control Center and tap Screen Mirroring
Pick the name shown here. Your screen and sound appear on the TV
Start when the TV turns on
Your iPhone can find the TV without opening this app first.
The app comes to the front when you start AirPlay.
Open the app yourself before you start AirPlay.
Needs \"Display over other apps\". Press OK to allow it.
Turn on \"Allow display over other apps\" for AirMirror TV, then press Back.
One more step on this TV
This TV hides the \"Display over other apps\" setting. To let the app open by itself, run this once from a computer with ADB:\n\nadb shell appops set %1$s SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
Get the newest version from GitHub.
Version %1$s is available. Press OK to install.
Version %1$s is ready to install. You have %2$s.
Allow AirMirror TV to install apps, then press Update now again.
This TV has no app installer. Download the APK from the Releases page instead.
Version %1$s is downloaded and ready. You have %2$s.
AirMirror TV %1$s is ready to install
Open the app and press Install. It takes a few seconds.
Show this phone\'s screen on a TV running AirMirror TV, on the same Wi‑Fi.
Looking for TVs… Open AirMirror TV on the TV if it doesn\'t appear.
Can\'t search this network. Type the TV\'s address below instead.
The address is shown on the TV under the receiver name. Sound isn\'t shared yet. Some apps (e.g. Netflix, banking) show black on purpose.
Waiting for %1$s. Press Allow on the TV if it asks.
%1$s is busy: an iPhone is using it. Try again when it stops.
Lost the connection to %1$s. Same Wi‑Fi? Is AirMirror TV open on the TV?
This phone could not start its video encoder.
Android did not allow screen capture.
Install AirMirror TV on the phone and open \"Share to TV\". One device at a time.
Android phone? Install AirMirror TV on it, open \"Share to TV\" and pick this name.
